# pyKT models (vendored)

`dkt.py` and `gkt.py` are copied unchanged from pykt-toolkit 0.0.38 (`pykt/models/`, MIT License, see LICENSE;
https://github.com/pykt-team/pykt-toolkit). Only these two files are used, so the package and its other
dependencies are not installed.

| File | sha256 |
|---|---|
| dkt.py | d6bc51dd70084301619560240a4ba49920e0278448984196fe886dd3993baae6 |
| gkt.py | 77d1f25eebed14a67936c32d031178191d50efbc1c5f15f32324315ba290a952 |

The adapter that trains and evaluates them under the engine protocol is `engine/deep_baselines.py`.
